operating_notes.text: Preferential issue of 1,17,64,705 convertible warrants at ₹425 per warrant (total ₹499.99 Cr); ₹136.25 Cr received and fully deployed into land acquisition as of March 31, 2026.
Total GDV stands at approximately ₹44,100 Cr as of FY26.
Acquired 100% equity stake in Tanirika Infrastructure Private Limited for a purchase consideration of ₹20.94 Cr.
Dubai project is launch-ready with all regulatory approvals in place, but timing is recalibrated due to ongoing regional situations; total investment in the project is close to ₹200-225 Cr.
Board approved scheme of arrangement for demerger of Satguru Corporate Services' Sunteck City 4th Avenue undertaking into Sunteck Realty.
Wholly owned subsidiary acquired approximately 4.5 acres of land adjacent to New Link Road, Borivali West, Mumbai.
Company adopted concessional tax regime under Section 115BAA during the period.
Total GDV of ₹46,880 Cr across 10 micro-markets as of Sep-2026.
Added ₹7,950 Cr of GDV in the trailing 12 months.
Borivali West land parcel expanded to 11.5 acres with an estimated GDV of ₹8,000 Cr.
